usedFor: Slide holds messages and contacts, and Sangam CRM keeps each new contact through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new contact is created” in Slide, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Leads are matched by ID, email or phone, so repeat contacts update one lead.

watchOut: “When a contact is updated” fires on every edit, so the same lead can be written twice.
